# agentmemory connect reference

Generated from `src/cli/connect/index.ts`. Do not edit the block below by hand; run `npm run skills:gen` after changing the `connect` flags.

<!-- AUTOGEN:agents START - generated by scripts/skills/generate.ts, do not edit by hand -->
`agentmemory connect [--dry-run] [--force]` wires agentmemory's MCP server into Claude Code (`~/.claude.json`). `agentmemory connect claude-code` is accepted as an alias. Any other flag or argument exits 1.

| Flag | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | show what would change in ~/.claude.json, write nothing |
| `--force` | rewrite the agentmemory entry even if already wired |
<!-- AUTOGEN:agents END -->
